title: List of generator outputs
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and positive $\ell$, and given a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$, form a list of vectors in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ by applying the executable small bias generator to every ordered pair of length-$\ell$ binary vectors, in the order determined by the Cartesian product of the lists of all such vectors.
hypotheses_covered: a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ is given
caveat: The exact ordering depends on the upstream definition of the list of all binary vectors, which is not supplied.
